methodology_and_caveats: Displacement data collected remotely between 26 and 28 October 2026 using 45+ enumerators and about 1,450 key informants.
Key informants include municipal officials, mukhtars, community representatives, neighbourhood focal points.
Collective-site figures are sourced from Disaster Risk Management (DRM) and Lebanese Red Cross (LRC) registration, accessed 28 October 2026 at noon.
DRM/LRC is household-level registration for direct assistance; IOM mobility tracking is an estimate for preparedness/resource mobilization.
Origin district figures are projections based on estimated IDPs living outside collective sites.
May 2026 Round 100 demographic chart is not representative at district or cadastral level.
IOM map boundaries are illustrative and do not imply official endorsement.
Only aggregate data is in the report; it does not report village/cadastre-specific caseloads for the 10 TON618 study locations.
Do not subtract returns from current IDPs to infer unmet needs or population resident in a village; return does not equal damage repair.
All figure percentages as published may be rounded; <1% is a threshold label, not an exact number.

ton618_website_integration.purpose: Use district-scale displacement and return figures as supplemental context to UNDP cadastral building damage data in TON618.
ton618_website_integration.suggested_join_key: district (with governorate where needed); never join district totals to individual villages as village measurements
ton618_website_integration.verification_needed: Check each mapped village/cadastre against matching administrative boundary identifiers if making geospatial joins.
ton618_website_integration.damage_dataset_comparison: UNDP damage snapshot uses imagery through June 2026; IOM displacement snapshot is dated October 2026. They represent different observation times.
sources_available: UNDP South Lebanon damage assessment July 2026
